title: Record explicit full Spark compute ownership
summary: James explicitly authorized Codex to stop competing Spark processes and take full ownership of Spark compute. The lead dispatcher may defer competing user workloads and their restart triggers while preserving source, queued work, outputs, restart state and essential host services. Current guidance now names both shared compute locks and the later reconstruction directory-entry block, and labels the 11 September pause as historical. This records authorization and the required controls, without claiming reclaimed resources, a native launch or a qualification result. The progress registry and historical receipts remain unchanged by this update.
next: The sole dispatcher records the actual workload deferral and verifies live reservation controls, resource ownership and both compute locks before a fresh model-bound native standing attempt.
